About.title: About Queenstown Local
About.description: What Queenstown Local is and where its places, events and notices come from.
About.intro: Queenstown Local puts what you need around Queenstown on one map: places to eat, drink, shop and visit, public facilities, what's on, and notices such as road works and closures.
About.audience: It is for visitors, people who live here and people who have just moved here.
About.places: Places come from OpenStreetMap and from the businesses' own websites. Each place shows its source and when it was last updated.
About.events: Events come from their organisers. Each event links to its official page.
About.notices: Notices summarise information from public sources such as Queenstown Lakes District Council. A notice marked Official comes from a public authority. Each notice links to its original.
About.original: Queenstown Local is not an official channel. If anything here differs from the original source, the original is right.
About.osm: Place data © <osm>OpenStreetMap contributors</osm>, available under the <odbl>Open Database License</odbl>.

Privacy.description: What Queenstown Local collects, why, and how to have it removed.
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what Queenstown Local collects when you use the website and what it is used for. You can use the map, lists and details without an account.
Privacy.account: If you create an account: your email address, your password stored only as a one-way hash, and the places you save as favourites.
Privacy.tokens: While you are signed in: sign-in tokens. The long-lived one is stored only as a hash and stops working after 30 days or when you log out.
Privacy.logs: Request logs kept by our servers and hosting providers, which include your IP address. They are used to keep the service secure, for example to slow down repeated sign-in attempts, and to fix problems.
Privacy.location: Only if you press the location button, your browser shares your position with the page. It is used to show where you are and to sort places by distance, and it is sent with those requests. It is not stored.
Privacy.cookies: Cookies keep you signed in. The ones that hold your sign-in cannot be read by the page's scripts; one more, which holds nothing but the fact that you are signed in, can be. Your browser also keeps the map position for the current tab. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
Privacy.providers: The website and its database run with hosting providers (currently Render and Neon). Maps come from Mapbox, which receives the map requests from your browser, including your IP address. Each provider has its own privacy policy.
Privacy.keep: Your account and favourites are kept until you ask us to delete them. You can remove a favourite at any time with its heart.
Privacy.choices: To delete your account or to get a copy of what we hold about you, contact us. We will reply within 30 days.

Terms.description: The terms for using Queenstown Local.
Terms.intro: By using Queenstown Local you agree to these terms.
Terms.information: Queenstown Local brings together information from businesses, organisers and public bodies. We try to keep it accurate, but we cannot promise it is complete or up to date. Check the original source before you rely on it, especially notices about roads and safety.
Terms.official: A notice marked Official summarises a notice from a public authority. Each notice links to its original, and the original is right.
Terms.account: Keep your password to yourself. You are responsible for what happens under your account. Accounts that are misused may be closed.
Terms.links: Places, events and notices link to other websites. We are not responsible for their content.
Terms.changes: These terms may change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
